newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - White bids up, DNS mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - White bids up, DNS mixed.

text.p: Elevator bids for white wheat in the northern wheat belt were firm on Wednesday on export interest while spring wheat bids were mostly lower amid excellent crop weather from the Dakotas westward.

Farmer marketings were very light, with seeding finishing up in many areas. Dryness remained a concern in parts of Montana but some rains were forecast for the weekend. North Dakota daytime temperatures were in the 70s F on Wednesday.
Egypt's purchase of SRW wheat this week lent background support to wheat markets. Offers on CCC's tender to donate 13,500 tonnes of white wheat to Pakistan were due May 22.
Terminal prices for spring wheat eased a few cents in part to compensate for a slight rise in Minneapolis futures and lack of fresh new spring wheat export orders, dealers said.
